channel.title: Questo — Art, Culture & Sculpture
channel.description: Curated dispatches on Art, Culture & Sculpture

item.title: The Art of the Monograph
item.description: A passionate defense of heavy print monographs, archival bookbinding craft, and why physical editorial publishing remains the definitive summit of artistic permanence.
item.author: Mateo Silva

item.title: Digital Autonomy and the Minimalist Screen
item.description: A manifesto on reclaiming human cognitive sovereignty from predatory algorithmic feeds through intentional web design, ad-free typography, and quiet digital interfaces.
item.author: Elena Vance

item.title: The Resurgence of Material Culture
item.description: Why traditional hand-carved stone, interlocking timber sashimono joinery, and tactile physical artifacts are experiencing a profound Renaissance in our hyper-digital screen society.
item.author: Anne Hardy

item.title: Craft Over Convenience
item.description: A philosophical monograph on traditional subtractive sculpture, the geology of Carrara marble, and why physical human craftsmanship retains profound spiritual authority in an automated digital landscape.
item.author: Anne Hardy

item.title: The Death of the Card Grid
item.description: A critical critique of ubiquitous 3-column card layouts, template monoculture, and how brutalist asymmetric typography is restoring vitality to digital editorial publishing.
item.author: Elena Vance
